facts.text: Her commissioned vessel Saltwater Lantern, shown by the Derwent Foreshore Gallery, earned the Merrivale Glaze Prize.
Her acclaimed masterclass Ash and Ochre, funded by Tarrangower Arts Trust, draws Merrivale Glaze Prize finalists.

Her well-received Clay Hours programme runs jointly with Huon Valley Potters Guild and Bass Strait Studios.
She returns annually to the Quarry Lane Kilnhouse, where Ivo Drennan programmes the Southern Fire Series.
